chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, he said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me:

“If there are two Thursdays at the beginning of the month, then fast the first of them, for it is more virtuous. And if there are two Thursdays at the end of the month, then fast the last of them, for it is more virtuous.”
ai.seo_question: Which Thursday should be chosen for recommended fasting when there are two Thursdays at the beginning or end of the month?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a recommended ruling concerning voluntary fasting on Thursdays within a month. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that when two Thursdays occur at the beginning of the month, the first is preferable, and when two Thursdays occur at the end of the month, the last is preferable.
